SPATIAL INTRO / LOCAL RUNTIME AND SOURCE NOTICE
纸间行旅 / 本地运行资源与来源声明
Version: 39 / 2026-10-28

Original scene
The spatial-intro.mjs scene is an original implementation for Erick 张建华's
personal portfolio. It does not include purplenoggin.com's scene code,
characters, models, textures, branding or other assets. That website was a
motion reference only; its custom scene's copying license was not established.
No upstream author is represented as participating in or endorsing this site.

Three.js 0.186.1
Repository: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/0.186.1
License: MIT. Full unchanged license is distributed at
../three-0.186.1/LICENSE.txt relative to this NOTICE.txt.
Official build/three.module.js and build/three.core.js are locally minified
with esbuild 0.28.2 in ESM format; their relative filenames and inline legal
comments are retained. No third-party Three.js example models or textures
are distributed as part of this scene.

GSAP 3.15.0 / ScrollTrigger
Repository: https://github.com/greensock/GSAP
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/gsap/3.15.0
Copyright 2008-2026, GreenSock. All rights reserved.
License: Standard "No Charge" GSAP License, not MIT.
Official terms: https://gsap.com/standard-license/
Current canonical terms: https://gsap.com/community/standard-license/
The official pure ESM gsap-core.js, CSSPlugin.js, ScrollTrigger.js and Observer.js files
are locally minified with esbuild 0.28.2 in ESM format, retaining their
relative filenames and inline upstream legal comments. The scene uses
GSAP numeric animation for Three.js values and registers CSSPlugin for
the DOM utilities required by ScrollTrigger. The index.js entry and
browser-global UMD distributions are not loaded or distributed here.
The upstream README.md is distributed unchanged. The npm package does
not provide a separate LICENSE file; this notice does not replace or expand
the official GSAP license terms.

Build tool
esbuild 0.28.2 is an MIT-licensed development build dependency only:
https://github.com/evanw/esbuild
It is not included as a website runtime or downloaded by visitors.

Delivery boundary
All listed scene runtime files are self-hosted. No external CDN, React,
React Three Fiber or source-site assets are required for the scene.
The build report records the actual output sizes and SHA-256 values only
after the build has generated or verified these files. Those byte counts
do not establish network performance, frame rate or Core Web Vitals.
